_note: Health flag wording, PLAN.md §4.10 and §11.2. Published ranges only; never names a condition; always points to a doctor.
doctorLine: A doctor can help you check what is going on.

short.title: Shorter cycles
short.body: Your recent cycles have been shorter than the {threshold}-day lower end of the range most guidelines call typical. A doctor can help you check.

long.title: Longer cycles
long.body: Your last three cycles included {count} longer than {threshold} days. That is outside the range most clinical guidelines call typical. A doctor can help you check what is going on.

longSingle.title: A very long cycle
longSingle.body: One of your cycles was longer than 90 days. That is outside the range most clinical guidelines call typical. A doctor can help you check what is going on.

variability.title: Varying cycle lengths
variability.body: Your cycle lengths have varied by more than {days} days over the last six cycles. That is more variation than most guidelines call typical. A doctor can help you check.

heavy.title: Heavy bleeding logged
heavy.body: You've logged heavy bleeding on several days for two periods running. Heavy periods are common and treatable; a doctor can help.

prolonged.title: Longer periods
prolonged.body: Your last two periods lasted more than 8 days. That is longer than most guidelines call typical. A doctor can help you check.

intermenstrual.title: Bleeding between periods
intermenstrual.body: You've logged bleeding between periods in two of your last three cycles. A doctor can help you check what is going on.

missed.title: No period for a while
missed.body: It's been more than {days} days since your last period. A doctor can help you check what is going on.
missed.pregnancyTest: If you have had sex since your last period, a pregnancy test can give you an answer.

missedFrom40.title: A long gap between periods
missedFrom40.body: It's been more than 60 days since your last period. Gaps like this are sometimes part of a change in cycle patterns. A doctor can help you check what is going on.

shortLuteal.title: Short second half of the cycle
shortLuteal.body: Your second half of the cycle (ovulation to period) was 9 days or less in two of your last three cycles. This is an insight only: ovulation dates from temperature are uncertain by a day or two, so a short count can be a measurement effect.
